title: A binding stored with its recipient under the key its channel reads in place of its declared one, naming no correspondent, is found at step 3 as the one room bound to the channel, and its recipient is admitted
notes: The channel declares phone_number and its recipient_address reads reached_at. The binding is written through the store, so no attach names its correspondent, and step 1, reading the declared key as stored, finds nothing; the room is the one bound to the channel, and Bob, the recipient the channel reads, is admitted there and recorded as its correspondent. The stranger's side: routing/step-three-reads-a-recipient-by-the-channel-s-own-method.
